rapport_notes: Excellent, personal, warm handling of a chatty repeat (4th-time) customer -- remembered the relationship and handled a discount request gracefully.

evidence_quotes.agenda: Not asked -- follow-up call confirming a submitted online inquiry from a repeat customer.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "If it goes under though my price will go down, right?" -> "Yeah, for sure, yes, so that's why we don't collect a front payment. Because you know you will only be billed for, yeah, for an actual hours ender."

top_strength: Turned a repeat-customer follow-up into a smooth booking with genuine warmth, and handled a loyalty-discount ask professionally ('I'll get in touch with the branch manager to check for discounts') without over-promising.
coaching_note: The no-hidden-fees/damage-coverage/Meet Your Mover/On-Time Guarantee differentiators were never walked through even though a booking resulted -- worth doing for consistency and to reinforce value on a larger ($1,455-$1,649) job.
